faq.q: What is the origin of Zeki?
faq.a: Zeki is associated with Arabic. Zeki is the Turkish form of Arabic ذَكِيّ (Dhākī), meaning 'intelligent, clever'.
Yes — the underlying form ذَكِي is Arabic.
Zeki can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Zeki should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Dhākī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Zeki mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Zeki is rendered ذکی and carries the sense ذکی، باهوش.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Zeki, zeki. Script forms are ذَكِي, ذکي, ذکی, ज़की.

faq.q: Is Zeki a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
